newsitem.title: INDIA: Six dead in India boat accident, dozens missing.
newsitem.headline: Six dead in India boat accident, dozens missing.

text.p: Rescuers pulled six bodies from a river in a remote area of northeastern India after an overloaded boat carrying about 130 people capsized, police said on Thursday.

Dozens of passengers were unaccounted for and feared dead after the boat carrying mostly Moslem businessmen and their families overturned on the Brahmaputra river, about 30 km (20 miles) from Guwahati, capital of Assam state, they said.
Thirty-five passengers swam to safety after the boat capsized late on Tuesday, police said.
"The boat was overloaded with passengers and bags of foodstuff," a senior police officer said.
